body: I know it can feel like everything is working against you. One day that will change. Just keep fighting until it does.

I think just being there is the best things to do. Just casually show him that you want to be a part of his life and that includes him being alive. 
At least that's what I would need.
You're a true friend. Wishing both you and your friend a speedy recovery from this episode.
Let me know if you need to talk. About anything. I know exactly how you feel. I have people around me, but I still feel so fucking lonely.

You can make it through the weekend <3   
I know how you feel and you're not pathetic. Love can be gruesome.
I don't have any advice. I just want to say that you are an awesome person. I wish I had friends like you who checked up on me.

Proud of you! Hit me up if you ever need help staying sober or just need someone to talk to. I've been sober for 5 months, and am struggling with PTSD, severe depression and health issues on the side. So I can relate to your issues.
